description: C1-07: minimal falsifiable eval for the north-star claim (first-attempt accuracy 30% -> 70-85% with a validated spec graph). Each task runs an agent twice on the fixture repo — once with the compiled graph exported into context, once without — and scores first-attempt success against expected_entities.
scoring: A task passes on a run when the agent's first delivered patch references every id in expected_entities (semantic matches allowed: file path or symbol containing the id) and none of forbidden_entities.

tasks.prompt: Add a due_date field to todo items and enforce that completed items may not have an empty title.
Which feature covers the 'persist todos' behavior, and what else does that feature require?
Rename the verify description 'rejects empty title' everywhere it is tested.
List every behavior in this project that no feature references.
Trace what happens after specforge init creates a project: which events fire and in what order?
What invariants guard the feature lifecycle, and which transitions are invalid?
Which verify statements of behavior coverage_diff are untested?
Walk the refinement chain that ends at a concrete layering check and name each level.
For diagnostic code E003: which behavior defines it, which event is emitted alongside it, and what suggestion does the renderer attach?
Which software entities are enhanced by the formal extension, and what fields does it add?
